decisions.reason: The decision changes the LED data-level-shifter part but does not alter which rails are monitored or the monitor topology.
The standalone USB requirement concerns the 3.3V rail and its LDO; the 5V LED supply and data-level shifter do not change that state.
The SK6812 chain remains the charge-status indicator on GPIO13; changing its supply and level-shifter component does not change the charge-status-output requirement.
The LED electrical-interface decision does not alter any panel control, touch input, button, switch, or reset mapping.
The source decision does not change the interboard connector architecture, signals, power rails, or pin-order policy.
This requirement already identifies the LEDs and their logic as 5V boost loads; selecting the 74AHCT1G125 does not change the boost enable, capacity, or load category.
The source decision concerns a 5V LED data interface and does not alter the 3.3V source OR-ing method or source-selection behavior.
No change to the main-board decoupling requirement is stated or logically required by the level-shifter substitution.
The LED connector remains part of the inventory, and the source does not add, remove, or change any connector.
The source specifies electrical level translation but does not assign or change any ESP32 GPIO.
The SK6812 data-level shifter is unrelated to the SDA/SCL series-resistor values, placement, and population policy.
The main-board LED supply and level-shifter selection does not change any sensor-board connector, pinout, or connector count.
